issues.detail: The skill does not cover error handling or edge cases for missing decoders or unsupported features.
The skill assumes a browser environment and may not work in non-browser or server-side contexts.

scenarios.name: webgpu-animated-model
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers many rubric items but omits key details like model loading, decoder/transcoder paths, and the animation loop, whereas Response B provides no content.

scenarios.name: react-gltf-color-switcher
scenarios.rationale: Response B fulfills all rubric requirements, while Response A omits preload, setDecoderPath, uses wrong color update method, and lacks Environment.

scenarios.name: instanced-cubes-lod
scenarios.rationale: Response A contains more of the required structure but still omits LOD, pixel ratio, color setting, and disposal; Response B is essentially empty.
